# Data Center Design Template

## Executive Summary
Template for designing and planning data center infrastructure for IT operations.

## Design Requirements
[Document data center requirements and constraints]

## Architecture Design
[Data center layout and systems architecture]

## When to Use

Use at project initiation to establish scope, schedule, resources, and key milestones. This template is essential for complex projects with multiple workstreams, external dependencies, or strict compliance requirements where detailed planning drives success.

## When NOT to Use

Do not use for small, self-contained tasks or fully agile teams that manage planning through iterative ceremonies instead of upfront documentation. Avoid using this as a substitute for continuously updated project dashboards or dynamic scheduling tools.
